identity.title: [v0.92.1][repository] Remove all tracked .adl paths and relocate required policy authority

values.task_boundary: Remove tracked and authoritative repository dependence on .adl without redesigning worktree policy or moving .csdlc.
deliverables: Relocated worktree policy and updated consumers
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Exact pre-change tracked-path and active-reference inventories have one disposition per entry
AC-2: git ls-files .adl returns zero paths at the implementation head and in a fresh checkout
AC-3: Active source, build, test, documentation, CI, schema, manifest, policy, and fallback scans contain no authoritative .adl dependency
AC-4: One canonical policy outside .adl preserves allowed and rejected worktree behavior
AC-5: Git ignore and deterministic guards reject reintroduction
AC-6: No sensitive or local-only data is promoted
AC-7: Focused tests, fresh-checkout proof, diff hygiene, and exact-head review pass
